nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Maternal health cash assistance
Type: Public Healthcare Service
Details: Safe motherhood programme providing conditional cash assistance for eligible pregnant women for institutional delivery.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Pregnant women meeting applicable state/UT category, age, parity and other current JSY conditions; rules vary by state/UT.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Pregnancy/MCP card or ANC records, identity and bank details, plus state-required eligibility documents.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Contact local ASHA/ANM, primary health centre or government health facility; follow state health department process.
Official Portal: https://nhm.gov.in/
